-/

namespace Erdos479

/--
Is it true that, for all $k\neq 1$, there are infinitely many $n$ such that
$2^n\equiv k\pmod{n}$?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem erdos_479 : answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ᵉ (k > 1), { n | 2 ^ n ≡ k [MOD n]}.Infinite := by
  sorry

end Erdos479
